entry.summary: What is Database Sharding? Think of your database like a giant filling cabinet. As your app grows, that cabinet gets stuffed with millions of records, making it harder and slower to find what you need. Sharding is like splitting that giant cabinet into smaller ones. Instead of storing everything in one place, you separate your data-often by customer, region, or ID range into different databases(also known as shards). Each shard handles a smaller load of the total load which speeds things up. Imagine a library with one checkout counter. As more people come in, the line gets longer.
